title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・そして、烈風

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For Yamanin Zephyr, a medium-distance race feels like a marathon. With my cheers pushing her ahead, however, she musters the last of her strength and reaches the realm of the supreme.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume standing beside Symboli Rudolf quietly whispers, "You are the true wind."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With victory in the autumn Tenno Sho, Zephyr achieves her goal of becoming a triple-distance champion, a feat that eluded even the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Tokai Teio is still in physical therapy. Lamenting that Zephyr surpassed her "Emperor" first, she vows to make a miraculous comeback at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr has achieved her goal, but she still isn't satisfied. Hoping to become an even stronger and freer wind, she keeps on running.
